ValidationRule.description: Freight Implementation: eQ Customer # is Mandatory if RevenueStream is Domestic.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
OR( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Freight_Account" ),
ISPICKVAL( Freight_Revenue_Stream__c , "DOM"),
ISPICKVAL( Type , "Freight-Branch"),
(ISBLANK(Freight_eQ_Reference__c))
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide eQ Customer #, If Revenue stream is DOM.
